name: Fubuki
alias:
Miss Blizzard (フブキ様, Fubuki-sama)
Blizzard of Hell (地獄のフブキ, Jigoku no Fubuki)
intro: Fubuki (フブキ, Fubuki; Viz: Blizzard), also known by her hero alias Blizzard of Hell (地獄のフブキ, Jigoku no Fubuki; Viz: Hellish Blizzard) is the B-Class Rank 1 professional hero of the Hero Association. She is an esper, the younger sister of Tatsumaki, and the leader of the Blizzard Group, a B-Class hero faction. She and her sister are known as the Psychic Sisters (エスパー姉妹, Esupā Shimai).[4] Fubuki is currently trying to recruit Saitama into her group.[5] She's also a self-declared member of the Saitama Grou
appearance:
Fubuki is a young woman with a curvy figure, straight, chin-length dark green hair styled into a bob with a fringe, pale white skin tone and light green eyes varying from jade to mint. She also wears light pink lip gloss. Her main attire consists of a dark royal-green, form-fitting V-neck dress with a high collar, often paired with a long white fur coat draped over it, thigh-high black heeled boots, and several white pearl necklaces (two in the anime).
Additionally, she sometimes wears dark tights and black pumps instead of her usual thigh-high boots.[6]
